item.title: Dutch Olympic champion Maarten van der Weijden sets backward swimming world record
item.description: Dutch Olympic swimming champion Maarten van der Weijden, 44, broke the world record for backward swimming on Saturday, covering 17 kilometers in eight hours at a pool in Zaltbommel.

item.title: Man injured in Hoogeveen stabbing; Suspect arrested
item.description: A man was injured early Sunday in a stabbing in the center of Hoogeveen, police reported.

item.title: Video: Seal pup rescued after wandering onto N15 highway near Maasvlakte
item.description: On Friday morning, firefighters found an injured seal pup on the N15 near the Maasvlakte and took it to the A Seal shelter in Stellendam.

item.title: 162,000 chickens culled after bird flu outbreak at Deurne broiler farm
item.description: Avian influenza has been confirmed at a broiler farm in Deurne.

item.title: Pilot, flight attendant barred after testing positive for alcohol at Schiphol
item.description: A pilot and a flight attendant were prevented from flying Saturday morning after alcohol tests at Schiphol Airport showed elevated levels in their blood, Dutch authorities reported.

item.title: Vandalism at Dutch stations drops, but costs still exceed 3 million euros
item.description: ProRail has reported a decrease in the number of vandalism incidents in Dutch train and bus stations. The number of reports has dropped from 4,600 in 2024 to 3,600 in 2025.
